1. The post copy

4 days of notice. 16 days since the letter.

Governor Abbott's letter reached ERCOT on August 3rd. ERCOT was to tell providers how each large load in Batch Zero was classified by August 7th. It told the market that date would not hold. ERCOT committed to seek a good cause exception from the Public Utility Commission ahead of the August 20th open meeting. That meeting is 1 day out.

The press release says the audit must be complete "before any data center project moves forward". The signed letter says "before any additional data centers are approved to move forward". Same office, same day.

On August 18th the Governor's office said the sector's membership body will comply with his standards.

The deck sets both wordings in facing columns, gives a blank field to the one project the release does not name, and closes on every date and docket still open to you.

Which wording would a Texas county plan around?

#ERCOT #PUCT #BatchZero

The machine changed itself

  • the post takes its hashtags back, and a gate holds them there
    config/brand.yaml has always required three. knowledge/carousel/CAPTION_CRAFT.md listed hashtags under banned furniture as engagement bait, so run 2 shipped a post with none while every gate stayed green. A rule stated in config, a surface that ignored it, and nothing in between.
  • a new gate, coherence_check: the deck reads as one object
    the 2026-08-16 deck shipped eight slides with no progress counter anywhere and the 2026-08-18 deck shipped nine with one on every slide. Both were green on every gate that existed, because brand.yaml fixes the counter and nothing connected a check to it.
  • a count means the thing its own noun names
    a slide read 'three sources' over two distinct documents and aggregate_check re-derived it against len(from_claims), which is three claim ids. The gate confirmed a published miscount.
  • the render report window was 80 characters, so a gate could not see past it
    aggregate_check scans that report. Slide 1 was stored truncated mid sentence, so 'That date passed 12 days ago' was invisible to the one gate whose job is catching an invented number. Widened to 320, and the gate immediately demanded a declaration it had passed over in silence on every previous run.
  • the render report declares its own text window
    widening that constant made copy_sync_check compare every ARCHIVED report against today's value, so the 2026-08-16 deck went red on a deck that had not changed. The ruler had. A constant in the consumer is the wrong place for a fact about how an artifact was produced.
  • a new gate, sources_block: every claim id the deck prints must resolve
    first_comment.txt is the only place a reader can turn a printed id back into a document. This deck printed sixteen and the block listed seven. Nine resolved to nothing, including all three claims the run added and four of the five on the closing frame. claims_check, copy_sync_check and aggregate_check all passed, because none of them looks at a text file of prose.
  • bespoke_check was measuring the standing masthead rather than the drawings
    the coherence upgrade above put the wordmark, star, kicker, site line and counter on every frame, which is the point of them. This gate scored that consistency as sameness. On the closest pair it shared 50 tokens and exactly one was a drawing call, and the deck failed at 0.5508 against a 0.55 line on furniture alone. Same fault as the FURNITURE set one layer up, which is a vocabulary of CSS and JS keywords and could never catch markup introduced afterwards.

Each reverts on its own commit.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
